text:
ana: heads-up: deploy-bot auto-blocked canary for v3.0.0 due to failing staging e2e. Blocking promotion until we decide.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion paused for v3.0.0 (canary-2026-03-21). Failure groups: e2e-tests (image pull error). CI job: https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/8021

jordan: logs show docker pull error + checksum mismatch from registry-proxy: `digest mismatch` when pulling `gcr.io/redwood/canary:v3.0.0`. snippet:
```
ERROR: failed to pull layer sha256:deadbeef...: unexpected EOF (digest mismatch)
```

kevin: that looks like a corrupted push or proxy cache corruption. Could be transient. We have a change freeze window at 19:00 UTC. Options: (1) repush image, (2) pin canary to v2.10.5 (last good), or (3) retry promotion after registry garbage-collection finishes.

ana: I'd prefer repush now if it's quick. How long to rebuild and push?

kevin: rebuild+push typical ~8m. If proxy corruption persists, push will succeed but pull may still hit corrupted cache edge.

jordan: workaround: `/deploybot pin canary v2.10.5 --reason "image pull digest mismatch v3.0.0"` then manual promote. That buys time for infra to flush proxy cache.

release-notes-bot: reminder: if you pin, include pinned version and rationale in release notes.

ana: ok kevin, please try a repush first. If we still see digest mismatch, we'll pin and promote last-good.

kevin: kicking off rebuild 8022 now (rebuild+push). Watching registry push logs.

deploy-bot: build 8022 started by kevin. Will update with status.

jordan: FYI I opened INFRA-4332 to investigate registry-proxy checksum validation + CDN edge invalidation.

kevin: push complete, registry reports manifest uploaded. Trying a pull from staging: `docker pull gcr.io/redwood/canary:v3.0.0` -> still digest mismatch on one layer from proxy edge.

kevin: confirming: master registry has correct digest, but proxy edge returns truncated layer. Looks like CDN cache evict needed.

ana: since change window approaching, let's pin to last-good to avoid delaying customer rollouts. jordan, can you run the pin?

jordan: pinning now. `/deploybot pin canary v2.10.5 --reason "registry-proxy edge digest mismatch for v3.0.0"`

deploy-bot: Canary pinned to v2.10.5 by jordan. QA smoke required before promote.

release-notes-bot: added draft note: "Canary pinned to v2.10.5 due to transient registry-proxy checksum mismatch on v3.0.0; infra investigating."

ana: QA smoke run started. If smoke green, we'll promote v2.10.5 and continue infra work on proxy.

deploy-bot: QA smoke succeeded. Manual promotion of pinned canary will proceed on approval.

jordan: promoting pinned canary now. `/deploybot promote canary --pinned`

deploy-bot: Promotion of pinned canary (v2.10.5) completed. Promotion timestamp: 2026-03-21T18:55:12Z

kevin: INFRA-4332: I cleared CDN edge cache for the affected prefix and asked registry operator to validate checksums. If all good we can attempt a redeploy of v3.0.0 later.

ana: thanks. Action items: 1) infra to add probe alert for registry pull digest mismatches, 2) add a small playbook for pin+promote when registry issues occur.

jordan: noted. Updating runbook and tagging infra team.

release-notes-bot: finalized release note entry for the pin.

ana: good job team. We'll target a reattempt of v3.0.0 after infra confirms proxy fix.
